purpose: Establish precisely where an Avid MDB video ExactEditRate interpretation belongs before Bella physical Duration arithmetic.

flow: Read own MDFL:Length and typed MDFL:SampleRate; preserve original count and rate pair.

actualFiles.purpose: Independent bounded actual physical MXF header comparison with exact full-ID paired MDB/PMR video records; no OldScanner oracle or media essence reading.
actualFiles.scope: All119 Shared MXF video files including113 fractional-rate cases and six25fps controls, plus two EDIT24fps controls where available.
method: All six MDBs and six PMRs are freshly hashed against prior receipts; all six cached indexes and prior duration findings are hash-checked. Only the two necessary indexes are parsed.
PMR v16 filenames use the established two-zero marker then strict UTF8; filenames locate candidates but never prove identity.

Exact full32 file and master IDs are matched to MXF SourcePackage and MaterialPackage IDs after reversible UUID field byte-order conversion of material bytes16..19,20..21,22..23. All other bytes remain unchanged; no truncation or fuzzy match.

MXF header KLV lengths, local-tag extents, primer count/stride and UUID strong-ref arrays are bounds-checked. Primer property ULs are resolved against the retained primary BBC/libMXF baseline schema, with registry-version-byte normalization. No production parser code is called.

The essence-linked SourcePackage must match full FileMobId; its own descriptor strong reference must identify a known picture descriptor. ContainerDuration and SampleRate belong to that physical descriptor.
Selected material-package track/sequence lengths remain separately labelled composition facts. They never replace the physical descriptor count.
Footer partition packs are checked for metadata; this probe reports an error rather than silently ignore a footer with additional metadata.
Physical file receipts hash only inspected header/partition ranges with unchanged size/mtime/inode. Whole media files and essence are not hashed or read.
limits: Header descriptor values are independently read from actual files, but encoded frames are not decoded or counted.
This corpus does not prove every possible decimal ExactEditRate alias or unsupported layout. An authoritative semantic decode rule still requires its native/format contract.
MDB and MXF raw fractions remain preserved separately; comparison does not declare unequal raw pairs mathematically identical.
No runtime implementation, extra header-read policy, source priority or display rounding rule is introduced.

independentAudit.scope: Independent read-only interpretation audit; no new native binary trace, app launch, media or repository change. Physical descriptor conversion details supplied independently by parent/native agent, not reverified here.
independentAudit.finding: Keep the original typed MDFL SampleRate pair. Apply a separately named format/field-aware interpretation only at physical video duration arithmetic; do not make it a universal wire reader or arbitrary rational/audio snapping rule.

primarySpecification.title: Avid OMF Interchange Specification v2.1, 18 September1997
primarySpecification.supported: MDFL Length is count in sample units, SampleRate is native sample clock; a referencing clip edit rate can differ. Rational is two signed32 integers.
primarySpecification.limitation: Published OMF2 property is Rational, not proof of private MDB ExactEditRate alias semantics.

nativeDistinctions.meaning: Reads pair then converts to decimal mantissa/exponent representation; does not directly perform NTSC rationalization.
Serializes decimal mantissa/exponent as a power-of-ten pair, independently of NTSC rationalizer.
Converts mantissa times power-of-ten to literal double; this establishes that a separate choice of interpretation exists.
Known23976e-3/2997e-2 aliases and integer multiples1..10 convert to24000/1001 and30000/1001 forms; exact normalized decimal equality.

architectureAudit.recommendation: Validate exact owner, typed count/rate and bounds; preserve raw pair; interpret supported physical video ExactEditRate aliases in a pure transient helper; compute count*interpretedDen/interpretedNum; round only for presentation.
scopeLimits: Do not apply NTSC alias conversion to generic Rational, already proper MXF rationals or arbitrary near decimals.
Do not infer every Media Composer UI or elapsed-duration path uses the same conversion.
Concrete/pulled audio clock selection remains separate review.
Unknown or unsupported representation must not bypass existing validity checks.
arithmetic: Two positive signed32 pair cross-products fit signed64 when operands are promoted before multiplication.
An arbitrary signed64 Length times a signed32 denominator can overflow signed64; use checked arithmetic/cancellation or suitable wider temporary when implementing.
Do not round source count/rate to a display label or milliseconds before duration arithmetic.

frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.purpose: Small pure DurationFormatter after the agreed AvidDurationInterpreter; requirements proposal only.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.inputs: Exact preserved duration facts plus a qualified display frame clock and explicit numbering mode.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.video: Length already counts video frames. Keep that integer count; use interpreted SampleRate as frame clock and a supported nominal base for labels.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.audio: Preserve selected MDFL Length/SampleRate as audio duration. Proposed display clock is own-file CPNT:EditRate, or supported own-slot MSLT:EditRate where applicable; never invent25fps or use48kHz asfps.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.audioRateInterpretation: Applying native ExactEditRate convention to the audio display EditRate is an additional proposed typed use; existing approved interpreter scope was physical-video MDFL SampleRate.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.frameConversion: Length * unitRateDenominator * displayRateNumerator / (unitRateNumerator * displayRateDenominator), with checked integer/rational arithmetic. Round only final audio display-frame count, nearest positive half-up proposed.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.nominalBase: Supported explicit mapping (e.g.24000/1001->24,30000/1001->30,60000/1001->60). Do not parse rounded Frame Rate strings or divide to elapsed seconds then appendFF.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.dropFrameSource: Propose own-file explicitly linked applicable timecode component and supported0/1TCCP flag, tied to compatible selected clock. Broader ancestor qualification remains unverified; no recursive sweep merely because reachable.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.dropFrameFallback: Proposed NDF when usable recorded flag absent, with absence distinguished from recordedfalse. Invalid/conflicting/incompatible flag handling remains undecided.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.precision: Preserve original count and fractions. Audio display can round to a frame without changing source samples. No extra saved formatted string or header read.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.knownZero: Agreed00:00:00:00; source-known zero distinct from unavailable.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.largeDurations: Agreedno24-hourwrap. Preserve safe padding; unsupported/custom/high-rate coverage remains tovalidate.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.claimsLimit: No actual-file DF availability count or universal Media Composer Duration-cell DF policy established. Layout and following recorded numbering are user choices. No app change.
